networkPolicy.desc: The Ministry of Transport's OutSystems server, and nothing else

notes:
An allow list, written from the binary and checked on a device. assets/capacitor.config.json sets server.url to https://transportation.outsystems.app/Haniti/ and that is where every screen comes from; the WebView's content security policy allows connect-src to 'self', transportation.outsystems.app/identity and *.amazonaws.com, and nothing else, so the application cannot fetch from anywhere the developer did not name.

Launched on the SM-A075F before it had network: every request in the log went to transportation.outsystems.app, plus two safebrowsing.googleapis.com lookups made by the WebView itself, which are not needed for the application to work.

*.amazonaws.com is not on the list. The CSP allows it, which in OutSystems usually means a file upload to a presigned S3 URL, and the bucket's host is only known at runtime. Nothing dialled it during the launch. If a screen that uploads a photo or a document fails, the tunnel log will show the exact host as WHITELIST_MISS, and that one host is what to add.

The base APK also carries github.com, highcharts, jquery, MDN and similar documentation links from the bundled JavaScript libraries, and sheets.googleapis.com from a chart library's data connector. None of them are dialled.
